<!-- Release: v0.8.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Local embedded and matching `.lrc` lyrics, with selectable synced/plain sources
- Integrated lyrics with active-line emphasis, fading edges, playback following, and tap-to-seek
- Independently configurable artwork tap/hold actions, plus reduced-motion and Back behavior

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/19 - Local lyrics and configurable player artwork actions

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.8.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Open Localica and choose your music folder in Settings.
